confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary widely by season, platform and room type, so they are less certain. July falls in the rainy season, which usually means lower demand, so accommodation may sit below peak. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local price relationship to beer because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page or the F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is general knowledge of Northern Thailand's mid-sized tourist-hub price level, set below Bangkok and Phuket. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from the local price relationship to beer.
